name: tpl-existence-two-3-goal
task: Be holding the key on at least two different moves, open the door and reach the goal.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: ExistenceTwo(hard, has_key) captures 'holding the key on at least two different moves'; the Existence(door_open) with Precedence(has_key, door_open) captures 'open the door' after the key, and Existence(at_goal) with Precedence(door_open, at_goal) captures 'reach the goal' after opening. Together the hard chain forces the key and the open door, so no extra Existence clauses are needed.
